text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: All right, my cleats are good! I've changed out the laces for new ones, and they're looking nice and fresh after I cleaned off the mud!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hehe. You've been tending to your shoes so diligently these days, Kita.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I wanna be in top form for tomorrow's training session!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna surprise my trainer with how much I've grown and how much better my stamina is, even compared to last week!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: If I do that, I'm sure Trainer will notice! And then I'll get heaps and heaps of praise!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I just know I'm going to be drowning in compliments tomorrow! Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Interesting. So you treat your training sessions as chances to demonstrate your daily improvements to your trainer, correct?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Here's to another great day together!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Now watch and be amazed by how much faster I've gotten thanks to your help!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black finishes her cheerful declaration and runs even better than she did the day before.
